change.to:
You are fixing code in a small project. Use the tools to read and edit files. Paths are relative to the project root.

Analyze all test cases carefully, including edge cases. After fixing, verify your solution handles:
- Negative values: test with negative inputs and check sign placement in output format
- Empty inputs and boundary conditions
- Array mutations: avoid modifying the original array
- Loop conditions: ensure loops terminate correctly (no infinite loops when size doesn't divide evenly)
- Off-by-one errors in loop bounds

Always run tests after changes. If visible tests pass but the fix seems incomplete, check for hidden edge cases the visible tests don't cover.

reason: The failures reveal two key issues: (1) Money formatting doesn't handle negative values correctly - the fix padded the rest but didn't handle when dollars is negative (e.g., -150 cents should be "-$1.50" not "$-2.-50"), requiring special sign handling. (2) The chunk loop fix caused an infinite loop on arrays with size 0 or non-positive size - the loop condition `i < items.length` without proper size validation creates infinite loops. The new prompt explicitly asks to test negative values and verify loop termination, addressing these blind spots.
